summary_md: **Packet.ai ([@getpacketai](https://x.com/getpacketai/status/2116085324895912353))** describes *BiLoCo* ([arXiv 2610.32243](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32243)), which stores low-rank quantization corrections as binary vectors for near-free accuracy recovery, aiding cheaper FP4 inference.

referenced_urls.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization

relevance: Quantization accuracy recovery relevant to running bigger models locally.
